item.title: Welcome to the Konedobu Lake: Port Moresby’s newest (accidental) landmark
item.description: For a first-time visitor driving down the Poreporena Freeway, the sight is almost scenic. There, nestled in front of the modern glass of BSP Haus, Kina Bank and the high walls of the Embassy of United States of America (USA), lies a vast, shimmering lake. But for the residents of Port Moresby, this isn't a tourist attraction it’s the Konedobu Field, and it's a seasonal failure we’ve come to expect. item.title: Regional Member condemns vandalism of churches in Selau Constituency
item.description: The Regional Member for Bougainville, Peter L. Tsiamalili Jr and the Minister for Works have issued a strong condemnation following reports of vandalism and threats targeting chapels and church properties in the Selau Constituency. Tsiamalili described the incidents as "alarming and unacceptable," emphasising that places of worship are sacred spaces dedicated to peace, unity, and moral guidance within the community.
